notes.title: Draugar Patch 1.0.6
notes.content: [h1][b]Patch 1.0.6[/b][/h1][h3]- September 1st, 2025[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Current difficulty is now visible to all non-masterclients in the lobby.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i][b]New:[/b][/i] [i]Added Player Stats. [/i][/p][p][i]\[Player Stats are accessible under your profile icon in the top right corner of the main menu.][/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45698026/2cd3bb60d6d1121d41884fed580305dd4893b5ed.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]The following stats will now be tracked:[/b][/i][/p][p][b]-[/b][i] Total Kills (*Was already tracked)[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b][i] Total Time in Matches[/i][/p][p][i][b]-[/b] Matches Played (Matches must be more than 1 minute long to count)[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b][i] First Time Played[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b][i] Hand Grenade Kills[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b][i] Nuke-In-The-Box Kills[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b][i] Elite Draugar Killed[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b][i] Shots Fired[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b][i] Times Downed[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45698026/c57d7ebd24d74b7e14b85dd8c4f8902a9a8554c3.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Further increased the chance of drops in higher rounds.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Made Draugar slightly faster past round 15 (Previously, Draugar only gained a slight speed increase after round 5 and round 10. With this change, they also gain an additional speed increase past round 15).[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Fixed issue causing the M1A1 Bazooka to obliterate Draugar a bit too violently.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] [i]Stay tuned for next patch, as it will bring a brand new addition to the Rifle Roulette machine.[/i][/p]

tags.balance_change: [b]-[/b] [i]Further increased the chance of drops in higher rounds.[/i]

[b]-[/b] [i]Made Draugar slightly faster past round 15 (Previously, Draugar only gained a slight speed increase after round 5 and round 10. With this change, they also gain an additional speed increase past round 15).[/i]

tags.bug: [b]-[/b] [i]Fixed issue causing the M1A1 Bazooka to obliterate Draugar a bit too violently.[/i]

notes.title: Draugar Patch 1.0.5
notes.content: [h1][b]Patch 1.0.5[/b][/h1][h3]- August 23, 2025[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Draugar can no longer spawn within 25 meters of a player.[/i] [/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Draugar can no longer spawn farther than 70 meters from any one player.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Reduced starting grenade capacity to 2 (was 4).[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Bullet Buffet increases grenade capacity to 4.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Increased cost of Bullet Buffet to $4,000 (was $3,000).[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Increased cost of Double Tap to $2,500 (was $2,000).[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Moderately increased visual recoil of M1 Garand.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Misc:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Updated the Round Complete text's font.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Adjusted lighting, skyboxes and post processing on Blodhavn and Dreadmill Farm.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Fixed issue causing the scoreboard not to update the cash amount instantly after buying wallbuys and perks.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Draugar should now properly avoid running straight through a wagon on Blodhavn.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Draugar ragdolls should now all consistently get thrown when killed by a hand grenade.[/i][/p]

tags.balance_change: [i]Draugar can no longer spawn within 25 meters of a player.[/i]
[i]Draugar can no longer spawn farther than 70 meters from any one player.[/i]
[i]Moderately increased visual recoil of M1 Garand.[/i]

tags.bug: [i]Fixed issue causing the scoreboard not to update the cash amount instantly after buying wallbuys and perks.[/i]
[i]Draugar should now properly avoid running straight through a wagon on Blodhavn.[/i]
[i]Draugar ragdolls should now all consistently get thrown when killed by a hand grenade.[/i]

notes.title: Draugar Patch 1.0.4
notes.content: [h1][b]Patch 1.0.4[/b][/h1][h3]- August 22, 2025[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h3][p][b]- Blodhavn:[/b] [i]Improved and added collision hitboxes to certain areas.[/i][/p][p][b]- Blodhavn:[/b] [i]Made the courtyard a separate, unlockable sector.[/i][/p][p][b]- Blodhavn:[/b] [i]Moved a perk spawn location into the courtyard.[/i][/p][p][b]- Blodhavn:[/b] [i]Increased cost of M1 Thompson wallbuy to $2,000 (was $1,500).[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Cash is now given out on a per-kill basis rather than a per-hit basis to make all weapons equally economically viable.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]$125 per Draugr killed.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]$250 per Elite Draugr killed.[/i] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Draugar can no longer push players out-of-bounds.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Fixed an issue where the sector border interaction UI would stay active even when looking away.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Misc:[/b] [/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Increased the LOD distance of pebbles.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Reminder:[/b][/h3][p][i]If you're interested, don't forget to join the [/i][url="https://discord.gg/G2ft79jnRM"]Draugar Discord[/url][i] server. It's the best way to[/i][/p][p][i]stay up-to-date with every new patch note, and you can get to personally have an impact on the[/i][/p][p][i]game's future, as the server has a dedicated suggestions channel, as well as a bug reporting channel.[/i][/p]

tags.feature: - Blodhavn: Made the courtyard a separate, unlockable sector.
- Blodhavn: Moved a perk spawn location into the courtyard.

tags.balance_change: - Blodhavn: Increased cost of M1 Thompson wallbuy to $2,000 (was $1,500).
- Cash is now given out on a per-kill basis rather than a per-hit basis to make all weapons equally economically viable.

tags.bug: - Draugar can no longer push players out-of-bounds.
- Fixed an issue where the sector border interaction UI would stay active even when looking away.

tags.feature: - Increased the LOD distance of pebbles.

notes.title: Draugar Patch 1.0.3
notes.content: [h1]Draugar Patch 1.0.3[/h1][h3]- August 19, 2025[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h3][p][b]- Guns:[/b][/p][p]	[b]- M1 Garand:[/b][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Increased ammo capacity to 96 (was 64).[/i][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Increased ammo capacity with Bullet Buffet to 192 (was 128).[/i][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Increased body damage to 300 (was 100).[/i][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Increased head damage to 500 (was 300).[/i][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Decreased maximum hip inaccuracy to 1.5 (was 2).[/i][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Fixed animations[/i][/p][p]	[b]- M1903 Springfield:[/b][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Moderately decreased scope magnification.[/i][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Increased body damage to 500 (was 250)[/i][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Increased head damage to 800 (was 500)[/i][/p][p][b]- Perks:[/b][/p][p]	[b]- JuggerNog:[/b] [/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Has been renamed to "Adrenaline".[/i][/p][p]		[b]-[/b] [i]Increased cost of Adrenaline to $3,000 (was $2,500).[/i] [/p][p]	[/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Elite Draugar are now resistant to the Skull instant-kill drop.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Perk spawn locations are now randomized, causing more unpredictability to each game.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Rifle Roulette locations are now randomized on all maps (was exclusive to Blodhavn).[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Slightly increased chances of drops in higher rounds.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]UI:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]The name tag above player characters now also shows your player level.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]The name tag above player characters is now always visible within a certain range, not just when looking towards the player.[/i] [/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Some small general main menu refinements.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Fixed issue that caused Fat Man drops to not flicker on and off before they were about to get despawned.[/i][/p]

tags.balance_change: - Increased ammo capacity with Bullet Buffet to 192 (was 128).
- Elite Draugar are now resistant to the Skull instant-kill drop.

tags.feature: - Perk spawn locations are now randomized, causing more unpredictability to each game.
- Rifle Roulette locations are now randomized on all maps (was exclusive to Blodhavn).

tags.balance_change: - Slightly increased chances of drops in higher rounds.

tags.feature: - The name tag above player characters now also shows your player level.
- The name tag above player characters is now always visible within a certain range, not just when looking towards the player.
- Some small general main menu refinements.

tags.bug: - Fixed issue that caused Fat Man drops to not flicker on and off before they were about to get despawned.

notes.title: Draugar Patch 1.0.2
notes.content: [h1]Draugar Patch 1.0.2[/h1][h3]- August 15, 2025[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Added keybind remapping support in the settings menu.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Slightly reduced range of how far away normal Draugar can injure players from to 1.6 meters (was 1.7 meters).[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Slightly reduced the Draugr hitbox radius to account for the reduced attack range.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Fixed an issue where players would no longer be affected by gravity when in the pause menu.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Fixed an issue causing total player kills not to count properly across game sessions.[/i] [/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Fixed an issue where non-masterclients could collide with Draugr ragdolls.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Fixed an issue where non-masterclients would get granted several bonus-kills per kill.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Fixed an issue where only some clients could see other players' pings in the scoreboard.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Misc:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Added a direct link to the Draugar discord server in the main menu.[/i][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: - Added keybind remapping support in the settings menu.

tags.balance_change: - Slightly reduced range of how far away normal Draugar can injure players from to 1.6 meters (was 1.7 meters).
- Slightly reduced the Draugr hitbox radius to account for the reduced attack range.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where players would no longer be affected by gravity when in the pause menu.
- Fixed an issue causing total player kills not to count properly across game sessions.
- Fixed an issue where non-masterclients could collide with Draugr ragdolls.
- Fixed an issue where non-masterclients would get granted several bonus-kills per kill.
- Fixed an issue where only some clients could see other players' pings in the scoreboard.

tags.feature: - Added a direct link to the Draugar discord server in the main menu.

notes.title: Draugar Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: [h1][b]Draugar Patch 1.0.1[/b][/h1][h3]- August 5th, 2025[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h3][p][b]-[/b] [i]Hand grenades no longer collide with player models, leading to cleaner throw releases.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Adjusted difficulty values to make the game a bit more challenging. You're welcome... (You know who you are)[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Added a short, difficulty-independent delay before Round 1 can start spawning Draugar.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Added a light effect over the Rifle Roulette machine to make it easier to identify.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b] [i]Draugr drop sound effects no longer play over each other if two or more drops are picked up in quick succession.[/i]  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Map Changes:[/b][/h3][p][b]- [/b][i]Dreadmill Farm:[/i] [i]Disabled a random floating plane above the barn that had overstayed its welcome.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Content additions:[/b][/h3][p][b]+ [i]New Draugr Drop: The Fat Man[/i][/b][/p][p]    [i]- Nukes every Draugr currently alive, instantly killing them (if that needed clarification).[/i][/p][p][b]+ [i]New Perk: Panzer Chocolate[/i][/b][/p][p]    [i]- Increases player movement speed by 20%[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45698026/721ece230463ce29b405e862275dada54cb0f0cd.png"][/img]    [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45698026/36eb7a262a23c8c8055d623ce3f94dda27df61d8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

tags.balance_change: [i]Hand grenades no longer collide with player models, leading to cleaner throw releases.[/i]
[i]Adjusted difficulty values to make the game a bit more challenging. You're welcome... (You know who you are)[/i]

tags.feature: [i]Added a short, difficulty-independent delay before Round 1 can start spawning Draugar.[/i]
[i]Added a light effect over the Rifle Roulette machine to make it easier to identify.[/i]

tags.bug: [i]Draugr drop sound effects no longer play over each other if two or more drops are picked up in quick succession.[/i]
[i]Disabled a random floating plane above the barn that had overstayed its welcome.[/i]

tags.feature: [i]- Nukes every Draugr currently alive, instantly killing them (if that needed clarification).[/i]
